rationale: Edge-case lens ran cleanly and surfaced 2 blocking UI defects on the new file-location row (no truncation/tooltip for long paths; a 'Not available' message that can contradict a real cost shown in the same modal, since cost-enricher's correlation-file fallback can resolve a log the new field never sees), while 2 other candidates were dismissed as unreachable given the codebase's established non-empty-sessionId convention used unguarded elsewhere in this file. Acceptance was skipped because no spec/story exists for this change, capping confidence at low; the standards audit (commit-format, code-quality pass; security na — no guide at the documented path) came back clean with no coverage gap, and blind/verification-gap are out of scope for the balanced profile. No findings were deferred.

standards_review.notes: 4 commit subjects match <type>(<scope>): <subject>; type feat and scope analytics are allowed; imperative, under 100 chars.
Additive optional-field threading reuses existing helpers (copyButton/esc); new tests cover present/absent cases of agentSessionFile.
No guide at the documented security-patterns path; manual check found no issue — path is esc()'d before DOM insertion, only clipboard APIs used.

findings.title: File path row has no truncation or tooltip
findings.problem: The new file-location row renders s.agentSessionFile as plain, unstyled text with no max-width/ellipsis/title, unlike the branch and title cells elsewhere in this file (app.js:852-853) which already truncate long values with ellipsis plus a title tooltip.
findings.impact: A long absolute session-log path (common on deep project/home directory trees) has no whitespace to wrap on and no truncation styling, so it can overflow or be hard-clipped by the modal's overflow:hidden container with no ellipsis or tooltip to recover the full value.
findings.recommendation: Apply the same max-width/overflow:hidden/text-overflow:ellipsis/white-space:nowrap styling plus title=s.agentSessionFile used for the branch/title cells (app.js:852-853) to the file-path span.

findings.title: "File: Not available" can contradict shown cost
findings.problem: The row shows "File: Not available" whenever s.agentSessionFile is unset, but cost-enricher.ts's loadAgentSessionFile() falls back to the correlation metadata file (~/.codemie/sessions/{id}.json) when raw.agentSessionFile is absent (cost-enricher.ts:60-70), so hadLog/pricing can succeed through that fallback while SessionAnalytics.agentSessionFile (aggregator.ts:436), sourced only from raw.agentSessionFile, stays undefined.
findings.impact: A session can display a real, non-zero cost in the same modal while its file row claims no log is available, reading as an internal contradiction and undermining trust in the new file-location feature.
findings.recommendation: Source the displayed path (or its absence) from the same resolution cost-enricher uses, or soften the message (e.g. "File: not recorded") when hadLog is true but agentSessionFile is unset.
